clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Grimand's Armor takes shape through a test of Furen Longbeard's methods. Grimand Elmore crafts a helm from rare materials, meant to endure punishing blows in battle. For an Alliance warrior, it marks a step toward mastery.

Grimand Elmore tests Furen Longbeard's daring smithing methods at his forge in Stormwind's Dwarven District. Grimand had doubted the dwarven master armorer's theories. To put them to the test, a warrior gathers rare elemental and beast components in hostile territory and brings them to Grimand. He uses the materials to forge a reinforced helm built to endure crushing impacts.

Grimand's finished coif shows that Furen's metallurgic insights were sound. He treats the metal to withstand pressure and physical blows that would warp ordinary steel. Grimand gives the coif to the warrior who helped him, honoring Furen's craft and the warrior's resolve. The armor can help them hold the frontline against Azeroth's greatest threats.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can barely believe it! Furen's technique was a success, and this armor should withstand tremendous levels of stress.
Here you are, friend. And thank you. I wouldn't have believed Furen's discovery if you hadn't gathered the materials I needed to test it myself.
